info.title: NeuralNexus API
info.description: API for NeuralNexus site and services

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Is query enabled on the server

get.description: Requires a valid session; any authenticated user may look up any other user by ID.
Requires the admin:users scope, unless the caller is requesting their own permissions.

get.summary: Get a user by their linked-platform identity

post.description: Requires the admin:datastore scope. The store is created for the caller; no request body is read.

get.description: Identifies the store via the request body rather than a path or query parameter.
Identifies the record via the request body rather than a path or query parameter.

delete.description: Requires a valid session, but — unlike create/update — the handler does not check the admin:numberstore scope; any authenticated user can delete any record.

get.summary: Look up a player by name
Look up a player by UUID

post.summary: Look up players by name in batch
post.description: Body must be a JSON array of 1 to 10 non-empty names; Content-Type must be application/json.

get.description: Returns 204 (not 404) when the profile can't be found.

get.summary: Get a texture's raw image bytes
get.description: Fetches from Mojang on first request and archives to S3; served straight from S3/CDN thereafter.

post.description: Requires the admin:pet-pictures scope. The pet name comes from the request body when no {name} path segment is used.

get.description: The pet ID comes from the request body when no {id} path segment is used.

put.description: Requires the pet-pictures scope for this pet's name.

get.summary: Get a random picture of a named pet
get.description: The pet name comes from the request body (this route has no {name} path segment).

get.summary: Get a pet picture by ID

delete.description: Requires the pet-pictures scope for the picture's primary subject's pet name.

get.description: The picture ID comes from the request body when no {id} path segment is used.

put.description: Requires the pet-pictures scope for the picture's primary subject's pet name.

delete.description: Requires the pet-pictures scope for the picture's primary subject's pet name. The picture ID comes from the request body when no {id} path segment is used.

get.description: Proxies the GitHub releases API. With format=fml, reshapes the response into Forge Mod Loader update-JSON format instead.

get.summary: Get bee name suggestions (unreachable without a count)
get.description: Registered with no path parameter, so the handler's amount lookup always comes back empty and fails validation before any suggestions are read. Use GET /bee-name-generator/suggestion/{amount} instead.

Account.description: A user account. Write-only fields (email, password hash, salt) are never serialized.

PlatformData.description: Platform-specific linked-account data. Shape depends on the platform: for 'discord' this mirrors a Discord user object, for 'minecraft' a Mojang profile, for 'twitch' a Twitch user object. Sent as-is to the provider's account-linking record.

profileActions.description: Only present on full-profile responses (GET /mc/profile/{uuid}). Absent entirely on name/UUID lookups, which never populate it; an empty array means the profile was fetched and genuinely has no actions.

prime_subj.description: Pet ID of the picture's primary subject.

othr_subj.description: Pet IDs of any other pets in the picture.

MCHashSlug.name: hash
MCHashSlug.description: Texture hash, as referenced by a profile's textures property.

FormatQuery.name: format
FormatQuery.description: Set to 'fml' to get Forge Mod Loader update-JSON format instead of a plain release list.

UnsignedQuery.name: unsigned
UnsignedQuery.description: Set to 'false' to request signed texture properties.
